media.title: Warsaw Philharmonic orchestra — 25th-anniversary group photograph, 1926
media.description: Group photograph of members of the Warsaw Philharmonic orchestra, made to mark the 25th anniversary of the Warsaw Philharmonic in October 1926. A Blüthner grand piano is visible at right, with the organ in the background. Reproduced in „Światowid” no. 45 (1926). Source: Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe / Szukaj w Archiwach, unit 5969079, object 333267, former sygn. 1-K-7053.
media.altText: Black-and-white group photograph of members of the Warsaw Philharmonic orchestra posed indoors, with a grand piano at right and organ pipes visible behind them.
media.rightsNote: NAC lists the object as made available; the linked Source SRC0363 records copyright fields as no data. Treat as public-domain / archival context image.
